spec_provided_observability.name: Status Register (Read Status 70h)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: {WP_n, RDY, ARDY, VSP, CSP, R, FAILC, FAIL}; SR[5:0] invalid when RDY=0.

spec_provided_observability.name: Read Status Enhanced (78h)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-LUN/plane status; turns off other LUN output buffers.

spec_provided_observability.name: R/B_n open-drain pin
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Real-time busy line; observable on scope without ONFI traffic.

spec_provided_observability.name: Get Features (EEh)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Round-trip of timing mode / drive strength / ODT / training values.

spec_provided_observability.name: ECC threshold (CSP, EZ NAND Read)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: ECC margin low → host rewrites the page.

scope_observability: Logic-analyzer probing of CE_n / CLE / ALE / WE_n / RE_n / DQ[7:0] is the SDR debug path.
NV-DDR family adds CLK + DQS_t/DQS_c (differential probes for NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3).
R/B_n probe directly shows tPROG / tBERS / tR without protocol parsing.
Read DQ Training pattern (62h, NV-DDR3) is fixed — useful for eye-diagram capture.
Write TX DQ Training Pattern (63h) + Readback (64h) round-trip for write-path eye centering.

training_for_diagnostic.name: Read DQ Training (62h)
training_for_diagnostic.purpose: Host sweeps RX phase against fixed device pattern.

training_for_diagnostic.name: Write TX DQ Training Pattern (63h)
training_for_diagnostic.purpose: Host writes training pattern to device.

training_for_diagnostic.name: Write TX DQ Training Readback (64h)
training_for_diagnostic.purpose: Device returns pattern for round-trip check.

ate_or_dft: Internal scan / BIST / charge-pump diagnostics are vendor-specific and not visible to the host via ONFI commands.
notes: ONFI provides protocol-level observability (Status / Parameter Page CRC / Unique ID complement / ECC threshold) plus NV-DDR3 PHY training observables. There is no JTAG / scan port on the package edge — internal die test is vendor-specific.
